name: 3D Floor Grid
description: A 3D grid world that lives in the layer's own 3D space like Particular: parent the layer to a Null and rotate the Null in X / Y / Z and the floor turns with it, while the real scene camera (Effect Camera Matrix patch) looks at it in true perspective. Floor, ceiling, tunnel or room planes, infinite or a board cut on the grid like a chessboard, grid, dots, circular or stripe styles, sub lines, checker fill, screen-pixel line width, glow, RGBA floor and background colors, distance fade, wall shade, switchable horizon glow and forward travel.
